candidate.name: Powder
candidate.description: AI Agents for precise document analysis
candidate.long_description:
Powder is an AI tool that helps wealth advisors rapidly create sales proposals that are personalized for each prospective client.  Using LLMs, Powder is able to automate a series of manual tasks such as understanding documents and conversations to create mind-blowing analysis that builds immediate trust.


Powder has 3 main features to automate sales workflows -

1. Brokerage, tax and estate document parser thats fast and accurate.
2. Meeting notetaker thats able to capture personalized insights.
3. Portfolio analysis tool that optimizes portfolio returns, risk and fees.

Our app saves hours of time and creates a pinpoint proposal that lifts a firm's ability to win new business.

founders.name: Kanishk Parashar
founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.bio: cofounder/CEO Powder - AI growth platform for wealth advisors.  Previously, I was cofounder/CEO of RCI Navigator.  Navigator helps asset and wealth managers to pace into private assets such as VC, PE, Infra, etc. while taking risks into account.  It was acquired by Addepar in Jan 2021.  Navigator is used by 150+ firms including UBS and Morgan Stanley.  Before that I was cofounder/CEO of Coin (YCW13).  Coin was a all-in-one digital credit card that combined all your cards into one.

founders.name: Soo Yung Cho

founders.name: David Goerz
founders.title: Founder

Co-founder & Chief Investment Officer for Powder Finance, which is building an AI Sales co-Pilot for wealth advisors to automate gathering financial holdings, analyze portfolios, assess risk tolerance, and summarize data to engage faster and efficiently.

He managed portfolio strategies for institutional asset owners for 33 yrs on mandates up to $30B in assets with pioneering innovations in quantitative equity and return forecasting, optimization and risk management. Chair, Investment Committees

score.thesis: AI-native autonomous agents owning high-value business workflows

analysis.team: Strong, domain-relevant founding team of four. CEO Kanishk Parashar previously cofounded/CEO'd RCI Navigator (acquired by Addepar Jan 2021; used by 150+ firms including UBS and Morgan Stanley) and earlier cofounded Coin (YC W13) (Founder bio: Kanishk Parashar). CTO Soo Yung Cho was a founding team member of RCI, also acquired by Addepar in 2021, with a CS degree from Johns Hopkins (Founder bio: Soo Yung Cho). Co-founder/CIO David Goerz brings 33 years managing portfolio strategies for institutional asset owners on mandates up to $30B, with expertise in quantitative equity, optimization and risk management (Founder bio: David Goerz). Dominic Tully leads sales/ops, previously at Addepar (Senior AE/AM) and started at Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management (Founder bio: Dominic Tully). The team combines technical depth, prior startup/exit experience, and deep wealth-management domain knowledge.
analysis.product: Powder is an AI tool that helps wealth advisors rapidly create personalized sales proposals for prospective clients (YC long description). It uses LLMs to automate manual tasks across three features: a brokerage/tax/estate document parser, a meeting notetaker that captures personalized insights, and a portfolio analysis tool that optimizes returns, risk and fees (YC long description). The stated value is saving hours and producing sharp proposals that help firms win new business (YC long description). In practice it reads as an AI sales copilot for wealth advisors rather than a fully autonomous agent (Founder bio: Soo Yung Cho).
analysis.market: Powder targets fintech and asset management, specifically the wealth-advisor sales workflow (YC tags; YC long description). The sources give no market size, TAM, competitor list, or customer/traction numbers, so market scale and competitive positioning are unknown. Why-now is implied by LLM capability enabling automation of document understanding and analysis (YC long description), but this is not quantified in the sources. The founders' prior product RCI Navigator reached 150+ firms including UBS and Morgan Stanley, suggesting familiarity with the buyer base, though that is a separate prior company (Founder bio: Kanishk Parashar).
risks: Product framing is mixed between execution and assistive 'copilot'/'insights' language, with no explicit evidence the agents act autonomously — weak fit against a thesis centered on autonomous agents owning workflows (Score breakdown: Autonomy 0/15; Founder bio: Soo Yung Cho).
No traction, revenue, or customer data is present in the sources, making commercial validation impossible to assess (Source material contains no traction metrics).
No market size or competitive landscape data provided; crowded advisor-tooling space risk cannot be evaluated from sources (Source material contains no market data).
Prior credibility rests heavily on RCI Navigator, a separate company acquired by Addepar — Powder's own outcomes are unproven (Founder bio: Kanishk Parashar).
what_would_change_our_mind: Evidence of genuine autonomy — the agent executing end-to-end proposal/analysis workflows with minimal human oversight rather than assisting (Score breakdown: Autonomy 0/15).
Concrete traction: paying advisor firms, revenue, or usage metrics demonstrating the product wins new business as claimed (YC long description).
Market sizing and a clear differentiation story versus incumbents in advisor sales tooling (currently absent from sources).
analysis.recommendation_rationale: Watch is appropriate: the team is a clear strength (10/10) with deep wealth-management domain expertise and a prior Addepar exit (Founder bios), but the product's alignment with the autonomous-agent thesis is only partial — execution language mixed with assistive 'copilot'/'insights' framing and no explicit autonomy (Score breakdown: Workflow ownership 17/30, Autonomy 0/15). With no traction or market data in the sources and a modest overall score of 51/100, the case merits monitoring rather than immediate investment pending proof of autonomy and commercial traction.
